title: Holcim raises stake in Cementos Pacasmayo to 93.7%
summary: Holcim raises stake in Cementos Pacasmayo to 93.7%
body_markdown:
**Peru:** Switzerland-based Holcim has completed a tender offer for all outstanding common shares in Cementos Pacasmayo for US$478m. The producer’s stake has risen to 93.7%.


Holcim first acquired a controlling 50% stake in Cementos Pacasmayo in March 2026.
